title: The Circus Comes to Town
description: Mai goes to the circus with her family.
instructions: Read about Mai at the circus. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🎪 Last Saturday, a circus came to Mai's town. There was a big red and yellow tent near the river.
Mai went to the circus with her grandmother and her cousin Sam. The show started at seven o'clock.
First, three clowns came in. One clown had a very big nose and funny green shoes. Everybody laughed.
Then a girl walked on a rope high above the ground. Mai was scared and she closed her eyes. Her grandmother held her hand.
After that, there were four elephants. They danced to the music and one elephant played with a ball. Sam took lots of photos.
At the end, the clowns gave sweets to all the children. Mai got a red lollipop. On the way home, she said, 'It was the most exciting night of my life!'
